title: Junebug Creek Rising Again
author: Marguerite Brightwater
blurb: Jonah Reyes, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
